item.title: Bruno Mars Soars on Latin Charts With ‘Lo Arriesgo Todo,’ Spanish Rendition of ‘Risk It All’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to the latest music update. Today, we're talking about a big comeback on the Billboard Latin charts. Bruno Mars is back, and he's making waves with his new Spanish-language single, "Lo Arriesgo Todo".
[Short music clip plays]
Host: This track, which translates to "Risk It All" in English, is Mars' first ever Spanish-language studio recording. Released on May 8th, it's already debuted at number 20 on the Hot Latin Songs chart, and it's claiming the top spot on both the Hot Latin Pop Songs and Latin Digital Songs Sales charts.
[Music transitions]
Host: But that's not all - when you combine all versions of the song, both English and Spanish, "Risk It All" is re-entering the top 10 on the overall Billboard Hot 100 chart. It's also climbing the Radio Songs ranking and the Adult R&B Airplay chart.
[Short music clip plays]
Host: This marks a notable return to the chart for Mars after a decade, and it's his highest-charting entry to date. In fact, "Lo Arriesgo Todo" is his first and only Spanish-language track among his seven career entries on Hot Latin Songs.
[Music transitions]
Host: So, what does this mean for Mars? Well, it's a big deal. He's now got his second top 10 entry on the Latin Pop Airplay chart, and he's proving that he can succeed in multiple genres and languages.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today. Thanks for tuning in to our music update. Bruno Mars is back, and he's bigger than ever. We'll be keeping an eye on his future releases, so stay tuned for more music news.
